arguments.description: A broad NATURAL jagged mountain ridge for a fantasy strategy game, as an isolated detailed pixel-art landscape layer. Three uneven summits of different heights, a sloping main cliff, deep irregular cracks, sharp rock shelves, rough ledges, weathered grey stone and sparse muted moss. Wide organic foothills taper into terrain; dramatic varied silhouette. This is an enormous rocky mountain rising naturally from the world, NOT a square tower, NOT stacked stone blocks, NOT a podium, NOT a pedestal or flat tile. No castle, building, road, grass tile, text, sky or cast shadow. Shallow three-quarter view, warm upper-left light, crisp dark selective outlines, deliberate detailed pixel clusters. Transparent background and lower ground anchor.
